golem.material.text.gadomancyawakened.si: Light and quick, and slowly repairs itself.
jei.gadomancyawakened.aura.exanimis: Strength II to undead; Speed to undead; Regeneration to undead; spawns brainy zombie.
jei.gadomancyawakened.aura.victus: Regeneration II; grows baby animals up.
jei.gadomancyawakened.info.arcane_packag: Made by the Arcane Packager from up to nine stacks, a leather and a string. Open it to get everything back.
Made by the Arcane Packager with essentia turned on: it uses a little Fabrico from tubes instead of leather and string. Open it to get everything back.
Ties up to nine stacks into one Arcane Package, and can disguise what is inside.
jei.gadomancyawakened.info.aura_core: Drop it near a vis crystal cluster and strike the cluster with a wand: the core attunes to a primal from the blocks around it.
jei.gadomancyawakened.info.aura_pylon: Stack pylons with a Pylon Peak on top, bind the peak with a wand and pipe essentia into the bottom: it breathes that essentia out as an aura.
jei.gadomancyawakened.info.block_protect: Fed Ordo from below; within its reach (up to 15) explosions break no blocks and endermen cannot teleport.
jei.gadomancyawakened.info.essentia_comp: Three stacked and bound with a wand. Holds 200 of each aspect, growing as it drinks an Element of Void from a pedestal beside it.
jei.gadomancyawakened.info.ethereal_fami: Crafting grid: the familiar with a vis crystal wakes it with that crystal's aspect; with an augment rune it learns that rune's trick. Worn as a necklace, it strikes hostile creatures.
jei.gadomancyawakened.info.familiar_augm: Give it to the Ethereal Familiar in a crafting grid. Make the levels of each rune in order.
jei.gadomancyawakened.info.infusion_claw: Two blocks above a runic matrix, holding a wand: a redstone signal starts the infusion in its owner's name.
jei.gadomancyawakened.info.knowledge_boo: On a pedestal, fed Cognitio by tube, it slowly adds theory in the category you choose.
jei.gadomancyawakened.info.node_manipula: Two blocks below a node with the Randomization Focus on top and ancient pillars at the corners: it changes the node, sometimes making it grow.
jei.gadomancyawakened.info.remote_jar: Use the item on a placed Remote Jar to copy its link, then place it: linked jars even out their essentia. Crafting grid: any warded, void or remote jar over a slimeball becomes sticky and can be placed on walls and ceilings.
jei.gadomancyawakened.info.revealing_len: Crafting grid: the lens with any helmet makes it show nodes and aspects like goggles.
research.gadomancyawakened.ancient_stone: The stones of the labyrinth are not beyond making. They are only stone, and patience.

Recipes for crusted, glowing, glyphed and runed ancient stone, ancient rock and strange crystals. As in the original these are off unless the world's Gadomancy Ancient Stones data pack is enabled (Create World, Data Packs, or /datapack enable).
research.gadomancyawakened.arcane_droppe: A dropper throws items out into the world. With a few changes it might also reach back out and treat the items lying in front of it as its own inventory.

The Arcane Dropper lets pipes, hoppers and golems take, insert and count the dropped items in a 3x3x3 area two blocks in front of its face, as if they were inside it. Anything put in is dropped out of its face. A comparator reads how many items lie in the area.
research.gadomancyawakened.arcane_packag: Carrying a dozen stacks of odds and ends is a nuisance. Tied up in leather they would fit in a single slot.

Put up to nine stacks in the Arcane Packager with a leather and a string, and it ties them into a single Arcane Package; open the package to get everything back. With essentia turned on it uses a little Fabrico from tubes instead of the leather and string. It can start by itself when its inputs are full, and it can disguise the package so nobody can see what is inside.
research.gadomancyawakened.armor_disguis: Good armour is rarely good-looking armour. With a little slime it could wear another piece's looks.

In a crafting grid, put a piece of armour with a slimeball and another piece for the same slot: the first keeps its protection but looks like the second. Use an invisibility potion instead of the second piece to make it invisible altogether. A water bottle in the grid washes the disguise off.
research.gadomancyawakened.aura_core.sta: Every place has a flavour of its own: a desert tastes of fire, the sea of water. A core blank enough could learn that flavour and keep it.

Drop a blank Aura Core near a vis crystal cluster and strike the cluster with a wand (84 of its aspect). The cluster bursts and the core slowly reads the blocks in a 9x9x9 cube around it. If enough of them carry aspects, the core takes one of the strongest primals among them, with the cluster's own aspect given a head start. Attuned cores go into Gadomancy's machines. Wash an attuned core in the crucible to make it blank again.
research.gadomancyawakened.aura_pylon.st: Essentia is the stuff of aspects, bottled. Released slowly into the air around it, it ought to make the place take on that aspect's nature for a while.

Stack Aura Pylons into a tower with a Pylon Peak on top and strike the peak with a wand (150 of each primal) to bind it. Pipe essentia into the bottom; it climbs the tower, and once a vis crystal has been drawn into the top section the pylon breathes that essentia out as an aura around itself, one point at a time. Each aspect has its own aura, from quickened steps and clear sight to fire, blight and stranger things. Use the peak with an empty hand to take the crystal back. Aspects with an aura: aer, alienis, alkimia, aqua, auram, aversio, bestia, cognitio, desiderium, exanimis, fabrico, gelum, herba, humanus, ignis, instrumentum, lux, mortuus, motus, ordo, perditio, potentia, praecantatio, praemunio, sensus, spiritus, tenebrae, terra, victus, vinculum, vitium, vitreus, volatus.
research.gadomancyawakened.block_protect: Creepers, endermen and stray explosions undo a careful build in a moment. Order, fed steadily into the ground, could hold the blocks around it where they are.

Feed the Block Protector Ordo from below with tubes. As it fills, its reach grows by a block at a time, up to fifteen. Within that reach explosions break no blocks, endermen cannot teleport (players and bosses are not held), and creepers lose their nerve. It burns Ordo slowly while it works and shrinks again when it runs dry. A comparator reads its range.
research.gadomancyawakened.essentia_comp: A jar holds what fits inside it. If the space inside could be folded in on itself, there would be no end to what one could hold.

Stack three Essentia Compressors and strike the middle one with a wand (140 aqua, 80 terra, 150 aer, 20 ordo, 140 perditio) to bind them. Tubes connect to the middle block from the sides. The stack holds 200 of each aspect to begin with. Set an Element of Void on an ancient pedestal beside it and the stack drinks the element slowly, growing by 350 per aspect each time, and pulls nearby creatures towards it while it works. Break any part and everything inside bursts out at once, along with a good deal of flux. The Element of Void is made by infusion; it blinds those who stand near it.
research.gadomancyawakened.ethereal_fami: A wisp follows whoever it has taken a liking to. Bound into an amulet, one might follow me, and fight for me as well.

Wear the Ethereal Familiar as a necklace. To wake it, put it in a crafting grid with a vis crystal; it takes that crystal's aspect. Once awake it strikes at hostile creatures near you, paying a little vis from a wand in your hotbar for each strike. Augment runes, made by infusion, teach it new tricks: put a rune in the grid with the familiar. Shock, fire, poison and weakness each make its strikes carry an element, and only one element fits; extra damage, reach and speed need an element first, and only one of those three fits too. Each rune must be one level above what the familiar already knows.
research.gadomancyawakened.familiar_dama: The familiar learns what it is shown. A rune of damage might teach it more.
Each Damage rune raises the familiar's damage by one level; make them in order, starting from level one, and give them to the familiar in the crafting grid.
research.gadomancyawakened.familiar_fire: The familiar learns what it is shown. A rune of fire might teach it more.
Each Fire rune raises the familiar's fire by one level; make them in order, starting from level one, and give them to the familiar in the crafting grid.
research.gadomancyawakened.familiar_pois: The familiar learns what it is shown. A rune of poison might teach it more.
Each Poison rune raises the familiar's poison by one level; make them in order, starting from level one, and give them to the familiar in the crafting grid.
research.gadomancyawakened.familiar_rang: The familiar learns what it is shown. A rune of range might teach it more.
Each Range rune raises the familiar's range by one level; make them in order, starting from level one, and give them to the familiar in the crafting grid.
research.gadomancyawakened.familiar_shoc: The familiar learns what it is shown. A rune of shock might teach it more.
Each Shock rune raises the familiar's shock by one level; make them in order, starting from level one, and give them to the familiar in the crafting grid.
research.gadomancyawakened.familiar_spee: The familiar learns what it is shown. A rune of attack speed might teach it more.
Each Attack Speed rune raises the familiar's attack speed by one level; make them in order, starting from level one, and give them to the familiar in the crafting grid.
research.gadomancyawakened.familiar_weak: The familiar learns what it is shown. A rune of weakness might teach it more.
Each Weakness rune raises the familiar's weakness by one level; make them in order, starting from level one, and give them to the familiar in the crafting grid.
research.gadomancyawakened.golem_bodygua: A fighting golem guards the place it was set to guard. I would rather it guarded me.

Use a Bodyguard's Badge on one of your golems. It follows you wherever you go, teleporting to you if it falls far behind, and attacks whatever attacks you or means to. Sneak and use an empty hand on it to make it sit and wait, and again to call it back to your side.
research.gadomancyawakened.golem_runic_s: The runic shielding I wear soaks up blows before they reach me. A golem is just a body; there is no reason it could not carry the same ward.

Use a Golem Runic Ward on a golem to fit it. The golem slowly gathers a shield of absorption on top of its health, as much as a third of it, or all of it for a silverwood golem. The ward recharges while the golem is not being hurt and stays on the golem until the golem is broken.
research.gadomancyawakened.golem_silverw: Greatwood makes a serviceable golem. Silverwood, steeped in magic as it is, ought to make a better one.

A golem carved from silverwood is light on its feet and slowly mends its own cracks, though it hits no harder than a greatwood one. Choose Silverwood as the material in the golem press; it takes a silverwood log and a simple mechanism.
research.gadomancyawakened.golem_tool_br: A golem told to break things does it with its bare clay hands, and slowly. Given a proper tool it could do far better.

The Seal of Tooled Breaking works like the breaker seal, but the golem first fetches a tool from a chest or other container under the seal and swings that. Better tools and stronger golems break faster, the tool wears as it would in your hand, and blocks drop as if you had broken them yourself, so enchantments count. Put blocks in the filter to choose what to break, and tools to choose which to take.
research.gadomancyawakened.growing_nodes: Once, after a manipulation, a node began to pull at the crystals around it. It was hungry, and it grew.

Sometimes the manipulator makes a node grow. A growing node draws in vis crystals lying nearby and adds their aspect to itself; it lashes out at creatures when it goes hungry for too long, and it swallows smaller nodes that come close. Fed long enough it can reach a size no ordinary node does, but a node grown too large can burst.
research.gadomancyawakened.infusion_claw: Starting every infusion by hand ties me to the altar. A claw holding a wand could do it for me.

Place the Infusion Claw two blocks above a runic matrix and put a wand in it. When it gets a redstone signal it strikes the matrix with the wand as its owner would and starts the infusion, paying 50 of each primal from the wand; between strikes it slowly refills the wand from the aura. Its owner must be online, since the infusion is started in their name. Sneak-use it with an empty hand to lock it so others cannot take the wand.
research.gadomancyawakened.knowledge_boo: Writing everything down takes up most of a thaumaturge's day. A book that reads and thinks on its own would leave me free for the rest.

Set the Book of Knowledge on an arcane, ancient or eldritch pedestal with open air above it, and sneak-use it to choose which research category it studies. Feed it Cognitio by tube; each point keeps it working for a while. While it works it now and then adds theory to its owner's understanding of that category, more often the more bookshelves and other books stand around it. Use it to see what it is doing.
research.gadomancyawakened.node_manipula: Nodes are what they are, or so everyone says. With enough vis pressed into one all at once, it might be shaken into being something else.

Build the Node Manipulator two blocks below a node, with the Randomization Focus on top of it. Stand an ancient pillar at each of its four corners with ancient stone on top. Strike it with a wand (100 of each primal) to bind it, then put a wand in it. It draws vis from the wand into its own store; once every primal holds at least 70 and the wand can give no more, it works on the node for fifteen seconds and changes it: breaking compound aspects apart, joining aspects, brightening or dimming it, changing its type, adding a primal, or rarely making it grow. The fuller its store, the more likely bad results are passed over.
research.gadomancyawakened.portal_creato: The eldritch eyes all look the same way, towards somewhere else. Enough of them, and a node torn open, might show me the way there.

Put the Portal Focus on the Node Manipulator in place of the Randomization Focus. Set four Eldritch Eyes on pedestals around it. Once its store holds 120 of each primal it spends twenty seconds tearing the node open; the node and the four eyes are consumed, and an eldritch portal into a fresh labyrinth is left where the node was.
research.gadomancyawakened.remote_jar.st: Essentia mirrors send essentia from one place to another. A jar with a sliver of mirror in its lid might share its contents with its twins, however far apart they stand.

Use a Remote Jar item on a placed Remote Jar to copy its link onto the item; place the item and the two jars are joined. Jars on one link slowly even out their essentia between them, so filling one fills them all. Sneak-use the item in the air to clear its link. Links are kept only while the jars are loaded, as with the original.
research.gadomancyawakened.revealer.stag: The goggles show what is hidden, but I would rather wear a proper helmet than a pair of spectacles.
Grind the goggles down into a Revealing Lens, then put the lens in a crafting grid with any helmet. The helmet then shows nodes and aspects as the goggles do.
research.gadomancyawakened.sticky_jar.st: A jar only stands on the floor. A little slime would hold it to a wall or a ceiling just as well.

Put a warded, void or remote jar in a crafting grid with a slimeball directly beneath it to make it sticky; it keeps whatever it holds. A sticky jar can be placed on any side of a block, walls and ceilings included. A jar on a wall or ceiling takes essentia in through its mouth from the block it faces, and tubes connect to it as they would to an upright jar.
